transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We need to get the command-post exercise roster finalized. The exercise begins Monday at 0600, and we have three desks to fill: movement control, communications log, and sustainment tracking. Our available personnel are PFC Ortiz, SPC Bell, and Sgt Noor. Before I publish the final roster, I need to run the standard pre-exercise process — qualification and availability readback from personnel, signal, and logistics staff. Can we get that readback going so we can confirm who's qualified and available for each desk?
